ModMetaData.name: RimObs
ModMetaData.author: RimWorks
ModMetaData.description:
Performance profiler and lag diagnostics for RimWorld. Find out which mod is eating your TPS.
RimObs records where every tick goes: timed sections, counters, gauges, histograms, GC events, allocation samples, and Harmony patch conflicts. A local collector daemon aggregates the data and serves a dashboard in your browser.
Every session goes into a local database. Play once with a mod and once without, then put the two hotspot tables and load orders side by side and see what actually moved. Any session exports as a speedscope profile for a real flamegraph, or packs into a diagnostic bundle you can hand to a mod author. The collector also exposes an optional Prometheus endpoint.
Needs a patching library to instrument the game: either Harmony (https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2009463077) or Concord (https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3758333473). Install one. With both, Concord wins. With neither, RimObs still loads and the collector still runs, it just records nothing from the game.
This mod ships the framework library plus the collector binary. Other mods that want to instrument their own code can depend on this mod and use the library API.
For full documentation, visit the project page.
